Elena / Jasmine —

Thanks for the options. Two quick operational notes from the serving/runtime side:

1) Model selection: we should shortlist 2 model variants per tier (latency-optimized and cost-optimized). I recommend:
   - Tier A (low latency): redwood-v2-small (fp16) + redwood-v2-int8 (quant) as fallback
   - Tier B (cost): open-llama-13b-quant + open-llama-13b-8bit (fallback)

2) Fallback rules: avoid cross-region fallbacks unless a region is fully saturated. Prefer same-region degraded model first, then same-region fallback tier, then other-region as last resort. This reduces egress and keeps latency predictable.

3) Load test plan: 2-minute ramp, 10-minute steady at target QPS, 3-minute cool-down. We will provide an ip-whitelist and short BPF for observability.

I attached an updated routing-policy-matrix.csv with marker columns for the proposed defaults (see "default_tier" column). Please review before we lock calendar.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
